schema.text: If your typical journey makes you feel tired, what do you think is the main cause?

options.text: Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling, carrying bags)
Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation, time pressure, feeling unsafe or insecure)
Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, noise, poor air quality)
Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in queues)
I usually do not feel tired after my trips

it.#If your typical journey makes you feel: Se il tuo spostamento abituale ti fa sentire stanco/a, quale pensi sia la causa principale?
it.#Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling,: Sforzo fisico (ad es. camminare, andare in bicicletta, trasportare borse)
it.#Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation: Stress mentale (ad es. traffico, orientamento, pressione del tempo, sensazione di insicurezza o pericolo)
it.#Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, no: Disagio ambientale (ad es. caldo, rumore, scarsa qualità dell'aria)
it.#Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in: Attesa e permanenza in piedi (ad es. alle fermate o in coda)
it.#I usually do not feel tired after my tr: Di solito non mi sento stanco/a dopo i miei spostamenti

fr.#If your typical journey makes you feel: Si votre trajet habituel vous fatigue, quelle en est selon vous la principale cause ?
fr.#Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling,: Effort physique (par ex. marcher, faire du vélo, porter des sacs)
fr.#Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation: Stress mental (par ex. trafic, orientation, manque de temps, sentiment d’insécurité)
fr.#Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, no: Inconfort lié à l’environnement (par ex. chaleur, bruit, mauvaise qualité de l’air)
fr.#Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in: Attente et station debout (par ex. aux arrêts ou dans les files d’attente)
fr.#I usually do not feel tired after my tr: En général, je ne suis pas fatigué(e) après mes déplacements

de.#If your typical journey makes you feel: Wenn Ihr typischer Weg Sie müde macht: Was ist Ihrer Meinung nach der Hauptgrund?
de.#Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling,: Körperliche Anstrengung (z. B. Gehen, Radfahren, Taschen tragen)
de.#Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation: Psychischer Stress (z. B. Verkehr, Orientierung, Zeitdruck, Gefühl von Unsicherheit)
de.#Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, no: Unangenehme Umweltbedingungen (z. B. Hitze, Lärm, schlechte Luftqualität)
de.#Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in: Warten und Stehen (z. B. an Haltestellen oder in Warteschlangen)
de.#I usually do not feel tired after my tr: Normalerweise bin ich nach meinen Wegen nicht müde

tr.#If your typical journey makes you feel: Tipik yolculuğunuz sizi yoruyorsa sizce bunun temel nedeni nedir?
tr.#Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling,: Fiziksel çaba (ör. yürümek, bisiklete binmek, çanta taşımak)
tr.#Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation: Zihinsel stres (ör. trafik, yön bulma, zaman baskısı, kendini güvensiz hissetme)
tr.#Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, no: Çevresel rahatsızlık (ör. sıcak, gürültü, kötü hava kalitesi)
tr.#Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in: Bekleme ve ayakta durma (ör. duraklarda veya kuyruklarda)

fa.#If your typical journey makes you feel: اگر سفر معمول شما باعث خستگی می‌شود، فکر می‌کنید دلیل اصلی چیست؟
fa.#Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling,: تلاش جسمی (مثلاً پیاده‌روی، دوچرخه‌سواری، حمل کیف)
fa.#Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation: فشار ذهنی (مثلاً ترافیک، مسیریابی، کمبود وقت، احساس ناامنی)
fa.#Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, no: ناراحتی محیطی (مثلاً گرما، صدا، کیفیت پایین هوا)
fa.#Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in: انتظار و ایستادن (مثلاً در ایستگاه یا صف)
fa.#I usually do not feel tired after my tr: معمولاً بعد از سفرهایم خسته نمی‌شوم

hu.#If your typical journey makes you feel: Ha a tipikus utazása kifárasztja, mi ennek Ön szerint a fő oka?
hu.#Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling,: Fizikai erőfeszítés (pl. gyaloglás, kerékpározás, táskák cipelése)
hu.#Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation: Mentális stressz (pl. forgalom, tájékozódás, időnyomás, bizonytalanságérzet)
hu.#Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, no: Környezeti kellemetlenség (pl. hőség, zaj, rossz levegőminőség)
hu.#Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in: Várakozás és állás (pl. megállókban vagy sorban)
hu.#I usually do not feel tired after my tr: Általában nem vagyok fáradt az utazásaim után

ar.#If your typical journey makes you feel: إذا كانت رحلتك المعتادة تسبب لك التعب، فما السبب الرئيسي برأيك؟
ar.#Physical effort (e.g. walking, cycling,: مجهود بدني (مثل المشي، ركوب الدراجة، حمل الحقائب)
ar.#Mental stress (e.g. traffic, navigation: ضغط نفسي (مثل حركة المرور، معرفة الطريق، ضيق الوقت، الشعور بعدم الأمان)
ar.#Environmental discomfort (e.g. heat, no: انزعاج بسبب البيئة (مثل الحر، الضوضاء، سوء جودة الهواء)
ar.#Waiting and standing (e.g. at stops, in: الانتظار والوقوف (مثل الانتظار في المحطات أو الطوابير)
ar.#I usually do not feel tired after my tr: عادةً لا أشعر بالتعب بعد رحلاتي
